text: I can draw the TCP three-way handshake and explain why it costs one RTT.
I can explain how TCP provides reliable, ordered delivery using sequence numbers, ACKs and retransmission.
I can distinguish flow control (receive window) from congestion control (congestion window) and explain slow start.
I can explain when UDP is preferable to TCP and give concrete examples (DNS, live video, gaming).
I can describe head-of-line blocking, why it affects HTTP/2 over TCP, and how QUIC solves it.
